identity.name: Royal Oak Selfwinding 41
identity.one_liner: The 2019-2022 Royal Oak 41mm with the new in-house 4302 movement — the most-cited modern Royal Oak, the one that ran 2019-2022 before the 15500ST was itself replaced by the 16202ST.

provenance_events.description: Audemars Piguet releases the 15500ST as the modern 41mm Royal Oak with the new in-house 4302 automatic movement, replacing the 15400ST.

narrative.story: The 15500ST was the most-cited modern Royal Oak from 2019 to 2022: 41mm, 10.4mm thick, in-house 4302 movement with a 70-hour reserve, a "Petite Tapisserie" dial. It replaced the 15400ST and was itself replaced by the 16202ST in 2022.
narrative.collector_notes: The 4302 is the same architecture as the 4300 in the Code 11.59 but with a different module layout.
